correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, fixed positive Poisson event rate Gamma and arbitrary Borel phase laws, normalized local rate g in [0,2] fixes EX=1-g for X=cos(theta). Maximizing E[T_n(X)] exactly gives the least GHZ decay 0 for even n, 0 for odd n and g<=1+cos(pi/n), and 1-T_n(1-g) otherwise. Even n supports +/-1; odd n has a concave upper envelope equal T_n on [-1,-cos(pi/n)] and 1 on the rest. Its second derivative is strictly negative in the left interior and its gluing derivative is zero; Jensen proves the unrestricted bound. The two explicitly symmetric atomic measures attain both branches and endpoints; Taylor gives coefficient n^2/(2sin^2(pi/n)). The GHZ qubit SLD calculation gives n^2*t^2*exp(-2Gamma_n*t). Independently evaluated Chebyshev second derivatives for n=3,5,7,11 as bounded corroboration, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Only fixed event rate, unconstrained Borel kick laws and GHZ-fixed-time QFI; no claim for density-only kicks or all metrological probes.
